os_list.name: FlightTracker OS (64-bit)
os_list.description: Minimal Raspberry Pi OS with the FlightTracker web installer pre-loaded. Recommended for Pi Zero 2W, Pi 3, Pi 4, and Pi 5.

os_list.name: FlightTracker OS (32-bit)
os_list.description: 32-bit build for maximum compatibility. Use if you hit issues with the 64-bit image. Supports Pi Zero 2W, Pi 3, Pi 4, and Pi 5.
